technical-summary: Tail quad rows kernel (lane_moe_rows_w4_quaddpp) widens E4M3 activations to fp16 two codes at a time (exponent/mantissa placement plus one v_pk_mul_f16 by 2^8) instead of one code at a time. All 256 codes bit-identical on gfx1030; replay output identical on 40 captured tail requests; quad kernel time -5.7% (304.5 -> 287.3 ms); cold 27k TTFT median -1.8% (p=0.018, 95% CI -4.7%..+0.7%); doc prefill and decode at parity.
user-summary-candidate: Long prompts start answering slightly sooner on the four-GPU layout because the tail GPU converts its input values in fewer steps; output is unchanged.
